prompt: Write an ADR for this: we decided that all timestamps in our public API will use ISO 8601 strings in UTC instead of unix epoch integers. Reasons: epoch integers caused repeated timezone bugs in client integrations and are unreadable in logs. Trade-off we accepted: clients now have to parse strings, and payloads get slightly bigger.

assertions.text: doc/adr/ is created with the canonical English seed 0001-record-architecture-decisions.md verbatim (only the date substituted) and the decision as 0002
ADR 0002 is entirely in English with the four canonical section headings (Status, Context, Decision, Consequences) in order
ADR 0002 has Accepted status, ISO 8601 date with today's real date, H1 '# 2. <title>', and one-blank-line discipline
The Consequences section includes the accepted trade-offs (string parsing for clients, larger payloads), not just benefits
